english.note: Use this for the side-facing surface of a three-dimensional object or for a side area viewed in relation to something.

examples.english: There is a scratch on the side of this chair.
examples.traditional: 呢張櫈嘅側面有條刮痕。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 dang3 ge3 zak1 min6 jau5 tiu4 gwaat3 han4

english.note: Use this for the all-purpose noun meaning a person's head or face viewed from the side.

examples.english: I managed to capture her profile in the photo.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jing2 dou2 keoi5 go3 zak1 min6
